summary: llama.cpp's server, build b11588 of 2026-10-13: the project's own CPU build for Ubuntu x64, unpacked from its release archive (decision 0035).
download: llama-b11588-bin-ubuntu-x64.tar.gz from the project's release on GitHub (17.7 MB, checked against its SHA-256); the folder holds about 60 MB after it

steps.name: fetch
run: rm -rf release.part bin.part && curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o release.part https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases/download/b11588/llama-b11588-bin-ubuntu-x64.tar.gz && echo '656cba79ba40776e766070145e6d6b2f23b06158803b0fa318fb95bdefa7dd23  release.part' | sha256sum --check --quiet && mkdir bin.part && tar -xzf release.part -C bin.part --strip-components=1 && rm release.part && mv bin.part bin
